headline: Abinader inaugurates the seventh cruise terminal in Samaná
summary: President Luis Abinader inaugurated Port Samaná, the country's seventh cruise terminal, as the MSC Opera arrived with about 2,045 cruise passengers. The port is part of efforts to expand tourism in Samaná.
why: Cruise terminals bring passenger spending and port fees to local tourism economies and attract hotel, retail and transport investment.
original_headline: Abinader inaugura en Samaná la séptima terminal de cruceros
